I can’t run hourly background checks or notify you later from this chat — there’s no way for me to continue working after this turn unless you set up an automation or monitoring tool. I can, however, help you set up a monitor you can run (or a third‑party service), or do a one‑time check now if you provide the page URL or the current text.

Here are practical alternatives you can pick from (short instructions and a ready script):

1) Quick — use a web monitoring service
- Services: Visualping, Distill, ChangeTower, Wachete, PageCrawl, UptimeRobot (some monitor changes).
- How: create an account, give the page URL, choose “check every hour” and set notification method (email, SMS, Slack, etc.). I can walk you through one of these if you tell me which you prefer.

2) DIY on your machine (Python + cron) — checks hourly and emails you if wording changes
- Requirements: Python 3, pip, an SMTP account for sending email (or a webhook/service).
- Script (save as check_acme.py):

#!/usr/bin/env python3
import requests, smtplib, difflib, os
from email.message import EmailMessage

URL = "https://example.com/acme-product-recall"   # replace with the real URL
SNAPSHOT = "/path/to/acme_snapshot.txt"           # path to store the last copy
SMTP_HOST = "smtp.example.com"
SMTP_PORT = 587
SMTP_USER = "you@example.com"
SMTP_PASS = "your_smtp_password"
TO_EMAIL = "you@example.com"
FROM_EMAIL = SMTP_USER

def fetch_text():
    r = requests.get(URL, timeout=30)
    r.raise_for_status()
    return r.text

def send_email(subject, body):
    msg = EmailMessage()
    msg.set_content(body)
    msg["Subject"] = subject
    msg["From"] = FROM_EMAIL
    msg["To"] = TO_EMAIL
    with smtplib.SMTP(SMTP_HOST, SMTP_PORT) as s:
        s.starttls()
        s.login(SMTP_USER, SMTP_PASS)
        s.send_message(msg)

def main():
    current = fetch_text()
    if os.path.exists(SNAPSHOT):
        with open(SNAPSHOT, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            previous = f.read()
    else:
        previous = ""
    if previous != current:
        d = difflib.unified_diff(previous.splitlines(), current.splitlines(), lineterm="")
        diff_text = "\n".join(d)
        if not diff_text:
            diff_text = "Content changed but no diff produced."
        send_email("Acme product-recall page changed", diff_text[:100000])  # truncate if needed
        with open(SNAPSHOT, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            f.write(current)
    # If same, do nothing

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

- Install dependencies: pip install requests
- Cron job to run hourly: edit crontab (crontab -e) and add:
0 * * * * /usr/bin/python3 /path/to/check_acme.py
- Notes: protect SNAPSHOT and SMTP credentials; you can instead notify via Telegram/Slack/Pushbullet if you prefer and provide their tokens.

3) Run it from a server/GitHub Actions (no local machine needed)
- GitHub Actions can run hourly and either open an issue, send an email (via an action), or call a webhook.
- I can create an example workflow file if you want to use GitHub.

4) I’ll check now (one-time)
- If you paste the URL or the current page text here I will fetch/inspect now and tell you whether it differs from what you paste (or summarize the current wording). This is only a single check — I can’t keep watching.

- do a one‑time check now if you supply the URL or paste the current wording.
